info.description: A lead submitted through the public Contact form. Entries are created only by the form endpoint (validated, honeypot-checked, rate-limited) and read by the team in the admin — never exposed to the public API.

email.description: Lead's email — format is validated by Strapi and by the submit handler.

service.description: Service the lead is interested in (from the dropdown).

budgetRange.description: Optional project budget range. Keep in sync with the frontend BUDGET_RANGES.

source.description: Referrer set by the submit handler — where the visitor came from.
